card.name: Words just before a time expression
card.fires_on: A word that comes right before a time phrase such as 'each year', 'this year', 'per second' or 'daily'. It also fires on a place or event name followed by a date.

modes.label: Frequency or rate words
modes.description: Words like each, per, once or /kg that lead into a rate or recurring period.
modes.example: around 35,000 people in shelters<< each>> night.

modes.label: Time-anchor words
modes.description: Words like earlier or of that lead into 'this year' or 'last week'.
modes.example: fell victim to NASA's shrinking budget<< earlier>> this year.

modes.label: Place or event before a date
modes.description: A place or event noun followed by a month or a time clause.
